scope: Final bounded source-only follow-up for normal-grave Bank-All, inventory dough motion and Empty motion

method.retained_evidence: Existing frozen recovery references, original native recovery scripts and pinned animation/variable symbols were reviewed without modifying their packs.
method.supplemental_query: Seven individual MediaWiki action=query requests, formatversion=2, prop=revisions, rvprop=ids|timestamp|content, rvslots=main, rvlimit=1, redirects=1 and rvstart at the cutoff. Exact returned revisions and response/text hashes are recorded below.
method.text_hash_encoding: SHA256 of the returned main-slot wikitext encoded as UTF-8, without normalization
method.negative_evidence_policy: Missing documentation, a missing named sequence, or an unconfigured native control does not establish deliberate no-animation or source-disabled permission.
method.stop_reason: The bounded retained/native/public evidence pass did not establish the three original-server facts. Repeating client metadata probes cannot supply server dispatch or authorization.

retained_sources.finding: Retrieval602 script1987 conditionally exposes Bank-All when varp263 is1 and the retrieval service is unlocked. Enums1753/1756/1757 interpret the service selected by varp261. Office669 instead uses varp263 as a unit fee and exposes1/5/X/All and Take-All, not Bank-All. Generic672 is a distinct normal-grave layout.
retained_sources.limit: The client condition does not establish the values or permission supplied by the original server for an ordinary M1 grave.

retained_sources.finding: These are generic interface scratch variables. The differing602/669 uses of IF3 do not define a global character banking entitlement.
The retained native sequence inventory and qualified dispatch references do not bind inventory dough or Empty to a sequence or deliberate absence. Sequence883 is pottery, not dough.
retained_sources.limit: Cache sequence existence or naming cannot establish which sequence an original server sends for an item action.

retained_sources.finding: Ordinary graves and Item Retrieval Services are distinct contexts; this reference does not establish ordinary-grave Bank-All permission or deliberate disablement.
The ability to pay retrieval fees from a bank is not authorization to retrieve items into that bank.
This is a gravestone object image, not a recovery-interface screenshot. It cannot establish Bank-All control state.

supplemental_pages.title: Item Retrieval Service
supplemental_pages.finding: Does not supply ordinary-grave Bank-All authorization or an explicit source-disabled rule.

supplemental_pages.title: Bread dough
supplemental_pages.finding: Documents mixing flour with water, including the Tutorial Island ingredients. It supplies neither an actor sequence nor an explicit no-animation statement.

supplemental_pages.title: Pot of flour
supplemental_pages.finding: Documents the Empty option and use in dough. It does not establish actor motion or deliberate absence for either action.

supplemental_pages.title: Bucket of water
supplemental_pages.finding: Documents the Empty option but not its actor motion or deliberate absence.

supplemental_pages.title: Bucket of milk
supplemental_pages.finding: Documents the Empty option but not its actor motion or deliberate absence. Milking is a different action.

supplemental_pages.title: Energy potion
supplemental_pages.finding: Lists Drink and Empty separately; it does not establish an Empty sequence or deliberate no-animation.

supplemental_pages.title: Potions
supplemental_pages.finding: The three-tick consumption timer concerns drinking, not Empty; it is not Empty-motion evidence.

questions.missing_fact: Actual original-server Bank-All permission, or verified deliberate disablement, for the ordinary M1 grave context.
rejected_inferences: A conditional602 button or an unconfigured IF3 value is not source authorization or verified source disablement.
Paying fees from the bank does not grant retrieval into the bank.
Office669 and Generic672 cannot silently replace the accepted602 association.
No mention in a page or no control in an object image is not a disabled-permission rule.
questions.retained_behavior: Canonical normal-grave Bank-All remains explicitly unavailable because its source permission is unverified. This is not a claim that the original game deliberately disables it. The real generic source-gated banking implementation remains unchanged.
questions.unblock_requires: A revision-qualified original-server observation of the correctly configured ordinary-grave context, including relevant IF1/IF2/IF3 values, control state and authorized action/result, or an explicit authoritative source rule establishing deliberate disablement for that context. Forced client variables, other retrieval services and Office fee semantics are insufficient.

questions.missing_fact: The original actor sequence and its action-relative timing, or verified deliberate absence, for flour-pot plus water-bucket inventory dough production.
rejected_inferences: The existing one-tick gameplay cadence does not prove no animation.
No dough-named cache sequence or no animation statement in the ingredient page does not prove no animation.
Pottery883, a nearby cooking object or animation0 is not a verified binding.
questions.retained_behavior: Keep the real recipe/action identity and current timing/output semantics. The motion rule remains Unverified, not a guessed sequence or asserted source silence.
questions.unblock_requires: A revision-qualified original action/actor-sequence trace covering the inventory interaction through completion, or an explicit authoritative per-action statement establishing deliberate absence. It must distinguish mixing dough from baking bread and pottery.

questions.missing_fact: The original actor sequence and its action-relative timing, or verified deliberate absence, for the seven bound Empty variants.
rejected_inferences: The Empty menu option proves an operation exists, not whether the actor animates.
Drink829, pickup827, pottery883, milking2305 and animation0 do not establish Empty behavior.
Drinking's three-tick timer cannot be used as Empty-motion evidence.
questions.retained_behavior: Preserve selected-item identity, existing container outcomes and gameplay semantics. Empty motion remains Unverified, not silently replaced with drink motion or deliberate no-animation.
questions.unblock_requires: Revision-qualified original Empty action/actor-sequence observations for the actual variants, or a verified common source dispatch rule covering them, sufficient to establish the sequence/timing or explicit deliberate absence. A drinking or milking trace is not an Empty trace.
